description: Header file defining structures, constants, and class interface for PID auto-tuning functionality in a firmware project. It includes parameters, tuning rules, and declarations for the PID_AutoTune class, used for automatic PID parameter tuning.

classes.name: PID_AutoTune
classes.description: Main class for performing automatic PID tuning using various algorithms and strategies.

methods.name: PID_AutoTune
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the PID auto-tuning object.

methods.name: Runtime
methods.description: Performs a tuning cycle; returns true when tuning is complete.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the tuning state to initial conditions.

methods.name: SetOutputStep
methods.description: Sets the output step size for auto-tuning adjustments.

methods.name: GetOutputStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current output step size.

methods.name: SetControlType
methods.description: Sets the control algorithm type for auto-tuning.

methods.name: GetControlType
methods.description: Returns the current control algorithm type.

methods.name: SetLookbackSec
methods.description: Sets how far back to look for peaks in the signal.

methods.name: GetLookbackSec
methods.description: Gets the lookback duration for peak detection.

methods.name: SetNoiseBand
methods.description: Sets the noise band threshold below which signal chatter is ignored.

methods.name: GetNoiseBand
methods.description: Returns the current noise band threshold.

methods.name: GetKp
methods.description: Returns the proportional gain after tuning.

methods.name: GetKi
methods.description: Returns the integral gain after tuning.

methods.name: GetKd
methods.description: Returns the derivative gain after tuning.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the current output value for the auto-tuning process.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the tuner state machine.

methods.name: setPeakType
methods.description: Sets the type of peak detection used.
